primary_effort: Turn a controlled lateral landing into a prompt return bound without losing receiving-leg alignment.
readiness_gate: Use connected lateral returns only after actual records show at least 2 controlled lateral stop landings per side at this small distance, organized low single-leg pogos at the selected support level, acceptable subsequent ankle/knee/groin response and current readiness. Prior vertical or forward success alone does not qualify a lateral return. Without the relevant evidence, use four discrete lateral bounds to a stop instead of the connected route. Do not increase bound distance or strength load today.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 jumps. 20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Retain a small bilateral braking reference before single-leg acceptance. Use a controllable vertical jump, coordinated ankle/knee/hip yielding and a 2 s hold. Lower height for stepping or trunk collapse.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 6 low jumps**, continuous. **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Prepare low-amplitude ankle return without tiring the receiving legs. Stay tall, knees soft and feet centered; settle the last contact. Reduce amplitude or stop for heavy contacts/knee pumping.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — two connected out-and-back bounds (proposed variant)
explosive.dose: **2 × 2 bounds per starting leg = 8 bounds total.** Each set contains one two-bound sequence starting left and one starting right. **60 s between starting legs; 120 s between sets and before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary anchor:** receive lateral momentum on one leg and redirect promptly back toward the start. Starting left: bound onto right, rebound onto left, then hold 2 s; reverse for the other starting leg. Keep distance small and pelvis organized; no foot shuffle, extra dip or uncontrolled trunk sway. Shorten the bound or use the hold route if the receiving leg collapses.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — three connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 3 jumps = 6 landings / 4 transitions. 120 s between sets and before E5.**
explosive.job: Retain the familiar bilateral elastic reference after the primary receiving-leg task. Use the same qualified moderate height, natural arm swing and continuous reversal; settle the third landing for 2 s. Lower amplitude or use the two-jump regression if the second transition deteriorates.

explosive.name: Broad Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 modest jumps. 20 s between jumps; 90 s before E6.**
explosive.job: Preserve forward braking with less support volume, leaving practice capacity for E3. Brisk two-foot takeoff, modest projection and a 2 s stable landing. Shorten distance if the feet reach far ahead or the athlete shuffles.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 4 low hops per leg = 8 hops. 60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Preserve a small single-leg ankle rebound demand distinct from E3’s held lateral landings. Keep the pelvis above the foot and the knee softly aligned; settle the fourth hop. Reduce amplitude/use support for rolling or rhythm loss.

replacement_routes.description: E3 four-bound hold route: 28 landings = 16 bilateral + 12 single-leg; 15 transitions; 44 limb contacts. E3 time is 200 s versus the connected route’s 380 s.

E4 two-jump regression removes 2 bilateral landings, 2 transitions and 4 limb contacts: listed E3 route becomes 30 landings/17 transitions/44 limb contacts; E3 hold becomes 26/13/40. E4 time falls about 2 s.

next_intended_job: Class 8 consolidates only the directional rebound patterns actually demonstrated, with lower planned contact volume and independent hold routes for each direction.
